description: React component for LDAP text setting in Mattermost admin console LDAP wizard, including validation, tooltip info, and LDAP test result display.

methods.name: sanitizeValue
methods.description: Converts input to string, handling null, undefined, and NaN.

methods.name: isFilterTest
methods.description: Checks if LDAP test result is a filter test based on test_name.

methods.name: isGroupAttributeTest
methods.description: Checks if LDAP test result is a group attribute test based on test_name.

methods.name: getTooltipContent
methods.description: Generates tooltip message based on LDAP test result and validation state.
